title: Dune: Part Two
synopsis: A desert prophet. A vendetta. A choice that will boil the sand.

nodes.text: Wind grinds the basin. A patrol below. Stilgar at your shoulder.

choices.consequence: Call the maker.
There is no taking “Order a quiet ambush” back. Patience shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A wall of teeth eats the dune. The patrol breaks apart.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Mercy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cold—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Six bodies, no shouts. A tag in Chani's hand with your face on it.

choices.consequence: “Hunt the traitor” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Anger.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Patient—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Reverend Mother watches you with old eyes.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Refuse” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Possible futures pour through you. Some are oceans of dead.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Mercy.
“Choose the swiftest justice” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Anger.

nodes.text: She loves you. She also doesn't love what you might become.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Promise her” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Tell her the truth instead.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You destroy a harvester. The Harkonnens send Rabban personally.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
You commit to “Ambush his transport.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: His thopter falls. He kneels, half-burned, begging.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “End him” back. Cold shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategic.

nodes.text: Sietch leaders argue your name.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Speak as one of them” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Power.

nodes.text: Halleck arrives with smugglers and old loyalty.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Embrace him.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Discipline.

nodes.text: Family atomics, sealed since your father. The risk is the universe.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Move them out” back. Strategic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Leave them buried.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A Sardaukar squad lands. You bait them into a worm field.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Letters. Her father is, you read between lines, terrified.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cunning—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Pride.

nodes.text: He looks at you the way he looked at no man before.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Care.
There is no taking “Let it carry you” back. Power shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You ride into the deep south. The crowds gather.

choices.consequence: “Preach plain” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
You commit to “Preach in their language.” The story records the instinct as “Power” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The council votes for jihad. You can still refuse.

choices.consequence: “Refuse” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Power—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The Emperor's frigate lands. Banners ripple. You take the field.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: The Harkonnen heir steps forward for a duel.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Accept” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: Shaddam kneels on the sand. The crown is in your hands.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take it as Emperor” back. Power shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: She watches you marry a princess for politics.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Run after her.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.

choices.text: Let her go to the worms
choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.

nodes.text: Banners spread to every horizon. You have seen this.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.

choices.text: Try one more time to steer it small
choices.consequence: “Try one more time to steer it small” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Green banners. Every horizon. You walk through it because you must — and you remember, every night, the futures where you didn't.
You refuse the crown. A council rules. Stilgar leads the desert. You marry Chani in a cave. The empire shrinks; the people breathe.
You walk south. The legend keeps moving without you. Some say that is the only ending where the desert keeps its god.
